venues.parkingDetail: Pre-paid parking passes are available for purchase with most event tickets. Parking can be found at the One City Center Parking Garage; entrances located at 23 Free Street or Monument Way, Portland, ME. Passes are valid for 8 hours (after a parking ticket is taken) beginning after 4PM. Customer is responsible for any time beyond that at a standard rate of $5/hour. Street Parking: Parking meters are in effect from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. [$2.25/ Hour. 2 Hour Max] Monday - Saturday. Sundays & city holidays are free.

Accessible seats will be held until all other seats are sold out, at which time they will become available to the general public. AURA has elevators to take guests with accessible needs between venue levels.

events.info: Experience the power of love at Disney On Ice! Feel the excitement as Mickey, Minnie, Donald, and Goofy welcome you into two worlds filled with heart. First, journey to wintery Arendelle with Anna and Elsa, where the chill of the ice melts into the warmth of sisterly love. Then, sing and dance with Mirabel and the Familia Madrigal as the story of Encanto bursts to life in vibrant color all around you. Don't miss sharing a little joyful mischief with Stitch and Angel as they bring nonstop laughter to the ice. Come be part of the magic, music, and memories at Disney On Ice presents Magic of Family! *Note: Costumes not permitted for guests 14 years & older. Visit DisneyOnIce.com for more information.
